body: #2751 (STORY-1728 slices 2+2b) is on origin/main at 18aa13a0a0. Every CLI command now lives in its own module, registered via aida-cli-lib/src/command_registry.rs, and the legacy Command enum is frozen by a ratchet test. Merge origin/main into agy/task-1332 (#2756) and agy/task-1744 (#2740) now; both conflict. Re-home your CLI arg and dispatch changes into the owning command modules, and regenerate cli_help_snapshot.txt for #2740. Then run check-ci-fast, check-ci-compile and targeted filters, push, and reply with the SHAs. Reviews start on push (they no longer wait for CI).
subject: #2751 MERGED: merge main into #2756 and #2740 now
